Generic-class ctors were compiled once, open, with erasure: any type-sensitive lowering inside them degraded to the reference shape - new Dict<T,int>() inside HashSet<T>'s ctor kept the dict key-kind bits clear (string mode), so int-key instantiations strcmp'd their keys (hashset_basic segfault, qa22 Bag<int> repro). EmitMethod mirrors the symbol via CtorSpecSymOf (multi-ctor classes append substituted param tags exactly like CtorSymNg - first draft omitted the tags and Transfer<string> failed to link, caught by the chart profile before ship). CtorCountNg and FitCtorIdx ignore sval2 ctors so clone registration can never flip the open class's single-vs-multi mangling or hijack open ctor resolution. Field initializers lower through the same open nodes, so the ctor prologue substitutes a clone for spec'd ctors.
